title: The Twisted Business Deal
story: In the shadowy world of high-stakes business deals, the disappearance of Mr. Benjamin Blackwood caught the attention of the city. Known for his shady dealings and countless enemies, it appeared he met his demise during a meeting held at his lavish penthouse suite. A cold, calculating man, few believed the rumors of internal conflict within his company.
crimeScene: The crime scene is a luxurious penthouse suite filled with expensive art and opulent furniture. A large, floor-to-ceiling window showcases a breathtaking city view.
forensicClue: A peculiar scratch on the doorknob leading to the secret room.
question: Who is the culprit and how was Mr. Blackwood killed? Remember to detail the step-by-step deduction.
